message.title: PitLog v1.6.3 Released 🚀
message.body:
PitLog v1.6.3 — Playbooks & Per-Rule Analytics
This update adds the Playbook system — a way to build named trading strategies with custom rule checklists, then measure how those rules actually affect your results.
What's new since v1.5.25:
📒 Playbooks — Create strategies with a name, color, and custom rules. Assign a Playbook to any trade directly from the trade modal.
✅ Rules Compliance — See per-rule compliance rates across all your trades, plus win rate and avg P&L when each rule was checked vs. skipped. Know which rules actually matter.
🗂️ Rule Categories — Group your rules into categories (Entry, Risk, Exit, Psychology). Compliance is tracked per category so you can pinpoint exactly where discipline breaks down.
🎯 Per-Rule Impact Analytics — Inside each Playbook, every rule shows its compliance %, win rate checked vs. skipped, ΔWR correlation, avg P&L, and an Impact Score. Rules with the highest behavioral edge get a 🎯 High Impact badge.

⚠️ To download v1.6.3: Check the first email you received from Payhip when you purchased — it contains your download link. Use that link to get the latest installer.
